history.content: hey. wasnt sure if id actually open this but here i am i guess
Hey — glad you opened it. No need to make it into anything yet; we can just take it as it comes.
yeah. honestly i dont even really know what id say. things are fine i think. work is fine, home is fine. its all just kind of... grey lately
Grey makes sense. Does it feel more flat and blank, or more like dull and tired?

blank i think. not tired exactly. i did this whole thing last weekend, drove out to see the fireworks with friends, everyone was so into it and i just stood there. like i was watching myself be there. i kept waiting to feel something and it just never came
That sounds really blank, and a bit far away from yourself. Is it more like detached, or like nothing was getting through?

nothing getting through, yeah. thats it exactly. its not that im sad about it. its just that the volume on everything got turned way down. i smile and say the right things and nobody notices but inside its just quiet. has been for weeks now and i cant even point to a reason

That sounds very quiet and muted inside, with the outside version still running on its own. We can leave it there, or if you want, I can stay with what it’s like when the volume is turned down like that.
you can stay with it for a sec. i guess the scary part is its starting to feel normal. like im forgetting what the volume up even felt like
That sounds like it’s becoming familiar in a worrying way. Does it feel more like forgetting, or like being pulled farther away from it?

more like forgetting i think. anyway. i dont know what i expected typing this out. it didnt fix anything but it was kind of nice to say it where i didnt have to pretend. thanks for that. im gonna head off
I’m glad you said it here, and you don’t have to keep going. It can rest there for now.
